image_format: lossless PNG for both masked variants
development_provenance: rules fixed from masks_v3 audit; v4 requires a filename-disjoint audit excluding v2 and v3 audit samples

pre_registered_binding_policy.red: strict HSV pixels >=40, y centroid <=0.50; if colored area >0.30 then detector-box aspect ratio must be >=1.45
pre_registered_binding_policy.green: strict HSV pixels >=10, detector-box aspect ratio >=1.90, and colored-pixel y centroid >=0.55

control_policy.object_exclusion: zero overlap with detections at exclusion confidence after 25%/minimum-6px box expansion
control_policy.signal_color_guard: at most max(2, floor(0.002*area)) strict red/amber/green pixels

validity_scope: measurement-development only; red-light binding and control contamination did not pass state-specific confirmatory gates
